generation_review.prompt: Draw exactly ONE new original Small Seal glyph from the attached historical reference. It shows four specimen slots of THE SAME character, THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Study ALL AVAILABLE specimens equally; UNAVAILABLE slots are absent evidence. Choose one coherent attested whole construction, do not blend incompatible variants, substitute modern Chinese, or reproduce reference brush outlines. Reconstruct original smooth centerline trajectories as a harmonious Gothic sans-serif MONOLINE drawing. Absolutely constant stroke width around 3% full canvas, round caps and round joins, precise straight bars and rounded smooth curves. No taper, swelling, brush pressure, texture, blobs, or serifs. Preserve every branch, detached stroke, counter, gap, contact and bar length relationship. Square1:1 canvas, one complete centered glyph within central70%, pure black strokes on fully TRANSPARENT background, generous margins. NO labels, text, codepoints, frames, grids, shadows, watermark, background, multiple glyphs. U+3D124. All four available and agree. TOP TWO separate threeprong Uforks, side-by-side at equalheight. Each fork centerstem projects slightly below Ubase. BELOW forks FOUR descending stream-like legs as coherent THX form: outerleft and outerright longcourses curve outward; middle maincourse starts between topforks, bends down-left then down-right into long inner-right leg, with one shorter innerleftbranch departing middle shoulder. Four separate lowerterminals. Keep lowerstreamassembly detached from both topforks, clear centralgap. No box, no crossbar, no extra fork.
